name: dev-digest-ai-marketplace
description: Four standalone Claude Code plugins extracted and generalized from DevDigest's course agent/skill set: shared engineering-practice skills, a read-only research subagent, an architecture reviewer that reads a repo's own layering docs, and a full spec-driven-development pipeline.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Shared, framework-level engineering practice skills (React, Next.js, Fastify, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Zod, TypeScript, security, layered backend architecture, frontend UI architecture, Mermaid diagrams, React Testing Library) for any TypeScript web app repository — the 'paved path' every other plugin in this marketplace builds on.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: A read-only research subagent for investigating a specific question, either in the current repository (code, docs, config, git history) or externally (web pages, docs, APIs), and returning a structured, evidence-cited findings report.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: A read-only architecture reviewer that checks a diff or path set against a repository's own documented layering rules (its onion/hexagonal/clean-architecture conventions, framework edge conventions, and frontend placement/import-direction rules), instead of assuming any one repo's specific module names. Returns evidence-backed findings, never a pass/fail verdict.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-driven development pipeline: spec-creator, implementation-planner, implementer and plan-verifier agents, plus run-plan, workflow-retro and engineering-insights skills, for taking a requirement from an evidence-based specification through an AC-linked plan, implementation, architecture/research review, and closed-list verification. Depends on engineering-paved-path for domain skills, research-tools for the researcher subagent, and architecture-review for the architecture-reviewer subagent.
